capabilities: Transcribe audio, video, and YouTube videos into notes
Chat with vault notes using file, folder, and tag mentions
Auto-organize inbox notes with folder, tag, title, and template suggestions
Turn meeting recordings into transcripts with action items
Connect to AI providers or a self-hosted backend
disambiguation: Not a chat-only assistant; it also transcribes media and automatically files and formats notes from an Inbox folder.
extras: Desktop-only in Obsidian (no mobile support). Freemium: 7-day free trial for the cloud service, self-hosting is free. Provider API keys are set on the backend, not in the plugin settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn unprocessed captures, recordings, and video links into structured, tagged, filed notes or to query the vault conversationally.

relations.evidence: Optional OPENAI_API_BASE for Ollama or other OpenAI-compatible endpoints

summary: AI plugin that transcribes audio and YouTube videos, chats with vault notes, and auto-organizes raw notes into folders with tags and formatting.
